title: Puzzle 3D Vortex Show Window Options
description: Puzzle 3D vortices must only be visible when their parent object is hovered or selected. Hide vortex markers otherwise so the scene stays uncluttered; keep vortices interactive once the object is engaged via hover/selection (and when a vortex on that object is itself hovered/selected so vortex-only selection still works).
summary: Added Puzzle 3D window option Vortex Show with Always and Selected (default Selected). Selected keeps the hover/selection emit gate in world_vortices_json; Always emits every object's vortices. Wired via runtime.vortex_show, measure puzzle3d-play-vortex-show, and view action setVortexShow. Covered by vortex_show_window_option_defaults_to_selected_and_switches_to_always and world_vortices_only_emit_for_hovered_or_selected_objects.
